draft.weaknessQuote: Lacks instincts and plays through a straw.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.37, the 31st-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 3rd of 26 at LB. He went 31st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Trevin Wallace. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (88th percentile), broad jump (85th percentile). College production: his final season (2024) ranked 2nd in tackles among the 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 17 career games and 10 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 6 AV in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 off-ball linebacker who played: 80 combined tackles against a median of 23, above the norm.
